title: "Supervision"

```{r}
source("R/bib.R")
esc <- function(x) gsub("\\|", "/", x)
```

## PhD theses

Click on a thesis title for its summary and publications.

```{r}
#| results: asis
phd <- read.csv("data/phd-supervision.csv", encoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(phd))) {
  p <- phd[i, ]
  cat("**", p$student, "** · ", p$period, "  \n", sep = "")
  cat("[*", p$title, "*](phd/", p$slug, ".qmd)  \n", sep = "")
  cat("Co-supervision ", p$co_supervision, " · Funding: ", p$funding,
      " · ", p$outcome, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Master's theses

```{r}
#| results: asis
m <- read.csv("data/masters-supervision.csv", encoding = "UTF-8",
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
names(m) <- trimws(names(m))
m$what <- gsub("\\\\&", "&", m$what)
m <- m[order(-m$when), ]
cat("| Year | Student | Topic | Programme and context |\n|---|---|---|---|\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(m))) {
  cat("| ", m$when[i], " | ", esc(m$who[i]), " | *", esc(m$what[i]), "* | ",
      esc(m$with[i]), " |\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Other supervision

- Examiner for master's theses, one or two per year since 2008.
- Academic supervision of research-oriented final-year projects: 6 Génie Industriel students; 7 double-degree students with Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) and 2 with Politecnico di Torino.
- Master 2 research supervision at Université Grenoble Alpes (5 students, M2 C2ES) and Université Lumière Lyon 2 (2 students).
- Introduction to research: about one M1 research project (TER) per year at Génie Industriel since 2010, two at ENSIMAG, and bachelor projects in economics and statistics (2016–2019).
